messages:
leo_sales: Dropped NIMBUS pen-test artifacts into the secure bucket per their request. They want full evidence + remediation timeline. Link: https://secure.redwood.example/nimbus/2045555555 :paperclip:
rg_audit_bot: Uploaded to s3://redwood-secure/nimbus/2045555555/ - report: nimbus-pt.pdf, raw-pocs: nimbus-pocs.tar.gz, scanner-xml: nimbus-scan.xml, manifest: nimbus-manifest.json, sha256: nimbus-2045555555.sha256 :package:
maya_se: quick review: several PoCs contain internal hostnames, a service token in logs, and one binary exploit. Legal will not allow raw binaries or creds to leave. We must sanitize first.
tess_eng: I can run the sanitizer and replace binaries with pseudo-PoC markdown. Plan: run `./tools/sanitize.sh nimbus-pocs.tar.gz > nimbus-pocs-sanitized.tar.gz` tonight and regenerate manifest. ETA: 1 business day.
oliver_ciso: Conditions for sharing: (1) release only sanitized artifacts unless they sign an NDA addendum; (2) include CVSS, attack vector, and auth-required flags in manifest; (3) designate NX security contact. Proposed SLA: critical=4d, high=14d, medium=30d. If they insist on raw PoCs require controlled access + review.
leo_sales: Nimbus's security asked for 30 days. I'll push our SLA back: critical=4d and offer an accelerated hotfix path for critical findings. Also ask whether they need weekly status emails.
maya_se: posted scrub guide: `scripts/redact_hosts_and_tokens.sh` — usage: `./redact_hosts_and_tokens.sh nimbus-pocs.tar.gz > nimbus-pocs-sanitized.tar.gz` (removes IPs, replaces hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, deletes token files, converts binaries to reproducible pseudo-PoC markdown).
tess_eng: sanitizer finished. Replaced hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, removed tokens, converted binary proofs to step-by-step reproductions. Uploaded sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-secure/nimbus/2045555555/sanitized/ and updated manifest.
rg_audit_bot: Audit entry: sanitized bundle published by tess_eng at 2045561200. Link expiry: 21 days. sha256: f2a3b4... nimbus-sanitized-2045555555.sha256
oliver_ciso: Reviewed sanitized package. Approve release to customer under these conditions: send sanitized artifacts + manifest + CVSS table; require signed SLA acceptance; if they require raw PoCs, sign NDA addendum and request time-limited controlled access. I'll sign the sanitized release now.
leo_sales: Drafting email to Nimbus sec: "Attached: sanitized pen-test artifacts, manifest, CVSS + proposed remediation timeline. Next steps: confirm SLA acceptance and indicate whether you require raw PoC access under NDA." Want SE to send?
maya_se: I'll send — will include the one-page Risk Acceptance template and a short runbook for the high findings. Also include the ticket linking fixes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NB-9003 (assigned to eng-auth). ETA critical fixes: 3 business days.
leo_sales: Nimbus asked for exact dates. Proposed: sanitized artifacts shared today, initial mitigations in ~2 business days (2045580000), full patch rollout in ~6 business days (2045610000). I'll include those in the email.
oliver_ciso: Fine. Note: if Nimbus refuses NDA addendum and still requests raw binaries escalate to legal and deny direct delivery. Also require they sign the Risk Acceptance form if they choose to accept residual risk.
maya_se: attaching RA template and runbook to the sanitized bundle and sending now. cc oliver_ciso and tess_eng.
rg_audit_bot: Notification: sanitized bundle shared with security contact nimbus-sec@corp-nimbus.com (pending acceptance).
